text: なげて　いいのは　ちきゅうなげ　だけ！

structure.jp: ちきゅうなげ　だけ！

patterns.name: 〜ていい
patterns.explanation: いい after a て-form verb says it is okay to do it. なげて　いい = 'it's okay to throw'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の here stands for 'the thing', so the words before it describe that thing. なげて　いいのは = 'the thing you may throw is'.

patterns.name: 〜だけ
patterns.span: ちきゅうなげ　だけ
patterns.explanation: だけ after a word means 'only that'. ちきゅうなげ　だけ = 'only Seismic Toss'.
